title: Minuta 2026-08-06
summary: The minutes of the 6 August meeting record a unanimous 5-0 hold at 6.50% with guidance to keep the rate at its current level, and the member-by-member section shows a Board still settled into a pause: no member argues for cutting and none for hiking. The majority keeps the inflation risk balance tilted to the upside and attributes the slower forecast convergence to persistent services inflation, while also citing slack, peso strength and anchored expectations as disinflationary forces. The spread of views is wide but balanced: one member says the real ex-ante rate at neutrality 'previene una mayor relajación', that the sufficiency of the neutral stance must keep being evaluated and that guidance should say rates stay until progress is consolidated; another calls for a robust stance and caution; on the other side, one member argues the determinants are 'observacionalmente equivalentes' to a restrictive stance and holds only 'en esta ocasión', and another stresses preserving flexibility to assess lower pressures. Versus the June minutes the hawk's sufficiency question is somewhat sharper and the dovish members' language slightly more open-ended, but the net tilt is the same, and it matches the same meeting's communique: a comfortable hold with upside-risk emphasis.

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno considera que será apropiado mantener la tasa de referencia en su nivel actual.
La mayoría consideró que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Majority keeps upside tilt to inflation risks

key_quotes.quote: Advirtió que la tasa real ex ante dentro del rango de neutralidad previene una mayor relajación.
key_quotes.context: Most hawkish member: neutral real rate rules out further easing; sufficiency of the stance under evaluation

key_quotes.quote: Argumentó que ello implica que estos son observacionalmente equivalentes a tener una postura restrictiva.
key_quotes.context: Dovish member: slack and peso make the neutral-range rate act as restrictive; hold justified only 'en esta ocasión'
